name: Wickedness
overview: Scripture reveals that wickedness brings death and judgment, as the wicked bear the consequences of their sin personally (Ezekiel 18:20) and face everlasting punishment (Matthew 25:46). The psalmist describes wickedness as dwelling among the wicked, leading to destruction (Psalms 55:15), while Proverbs teaches that ill-gotten gains profit nothing compared to the deliverance found in righteousness (Proverbs 10:2). Yet, God’s heart is for repentance, desiring that the wicked turn from their evil ways and live (Ezekiel 33:11), a hope fulfilled through faith in Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
